title: AS2 compiler: getTimer() should emit ActionGetTime (0x34) not ActionCallFunction
description: In AVM1, getTimer() is a zero-arg built-in that emits ActionGetTime (0x34) — it returns elapsed time in milliseconds since the SWF started. The AS2 compiler currently falls through to ActionCallFunction (0x3D), which calls a non-existent 'getTimer' function and returns undefined at runtime. Fix: in compiler.ts compileCallExpr, detect Identifier('getTimer') with 0 args and emit opcode 0x34 (no stack args needed). This is commonly used in Flash games for timing loops.
